hypothesis: A bounded-context agent reads and cites the measured v2 regression, then chooses an eligible origin while explaining how that evidence affected the choice. Same origin is permitted. A different origin is not proof of learning.
budget_explanation: Unchanged v2 PPO rollout rounding: 60000 requested, 61440 consumed. No training budget change.
process_pass_criteria: Actual LLM calls both outcome tools over MCP
Proposal cites the v2 outcome ID and explains the prior regression
Guardrail permits the model-selected compatible origin
Exactly 61440 consumed PPO steps and all 180 canonical validation episodes complete
A Decision, full tool trace, gate and connected child-parent outcome are retained
candidate_pass_criteria: Pass all four unchanged promo-1 checks. Report parent-child collision and goal deltas separately. A gate pass alone establishes no improvement.
interpretation: Report whether the origin changed and whether any suite regressed. No learning, causal planner advantage, physical safety or parent improvement claim from this single run.
failure_policy: One attempt only. No further retry, provider fallback or deterministic substitute. Record failure even before training.
safe_start_condition: Idle public worker, healthy FalkorDB, adequate AWS disk/memory, and at least 600 seconds before cutoff. Existing 120-second agent and 480-second worker limits remain.

context_budgets.token_bound_method: UTF-8 byte count is a conservative byte-BPE text-token upper bound; no tokenizer estimate
context_budgets.summary_policy: Top-ranked candidate rows, observed regression rows first, exact IDs and per-suite deltas; omitted rows labelled. Full graph properties fetchable by ID and full results retained in Decision.
